strongest_angle: An independent investigation concluded that allegations against the National Energy System Operator regarding a cover-up of blackout risks during the June heatwave were unsubstantiated, though the inquiry uncovered concerning issues with operational records and high staff stress.

key_facts.fact: An independent investigation by Eversheds Sutherland published on October 19, 2026, concluded that whistleblower allegations against the National Energy System Operator were unsubstantiated.

Engineers running Britain's electricity grid accused their bosses of misrepresenting the risk of blackouts during a record-breaking heatwave in June, according to an independent report covered by The Daily Telegraph.
Eversheds Sutherland was instructed on July 9, 2026, to investigate four allegations arising from whistleblower contact regarding operational records at the National Energy System Operator.
Staff at the National Energy System Operator experienced high levels of stress and felt their concerns were ignored, as reported by The Times on October 19, 2026.
